mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflation rate above 3.0% in CPIAUCSL triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to market expectations of tighter policy and reduced growth.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in inflationary periods do not turn negative despite sustained inflation, or p-value > 0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low FEDFUNDS rates and rising GDPC1 demand create favorable conditions for equity investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The combined signal does not result in statistically significant positive returns (Rank IC < 0.03) or p-value > 0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in UNRATE signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE declines in late-cycle periods, or p-value > 0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly growth in GDPC1 demand predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days as increased consumption and investment boost equity valuations.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth does not correlate with positive returns (Rank IC < 0.03) or p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO below 100.0 triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days as reduced supply growth signals economic contraction.
failure_condition: 20-day returns do not turn negative despite INDPRO contraction, or p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: High UNRATE (labor cost pressures) combined with falling HOUST (demand) signals weakening economic momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The combined signal does not result in statistically significant negative returns (Rank IC < 0.03) or p-value > 0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a sustained decline in INDPRO below 100.0 triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days as reduced supply growth signals lingering contraction.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain non-negative despite INDPRO decline in post-shock regimes, or p-value > 0.05.
